text_en: Please tell me that your friend is in good condition.
I had to improvise a torniquet and splint the frame, but he seems to be stable, despite the fall.
I hope the Lilis Radiantis will be of use to you.
The last thing I would want is to betray the trust mister Jivan has placed in me in caring for this orchard.
If there's nothing else I can do for you, I shall continue with my duties.
